title: Emerging artifact velocity and curator radar
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for harvesting sanctioned public velocity signals on brand-new open-source repositories, separating runnable engineering substance from star-farming hype, matching curator-lens heuristics, cross-linking existing seed archives without blind duplication, and proposing bounded verification, adapter and demo tasks.
boundaries: allow_authenticated_wall_scraping is locked to false; workers never scrape credential-gated social walls or bypass robots.txt or authentication checks.
Curator reference URLs act strictly as declarative public cross-post search lenses and human or agent canonical repository intake references.
Follow-up tasks are emitted strictly as bounded proposals with maximum_automatically_enqueued_children: 0 and never create a competing scheduler or task authority.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and executes no third-party repository code.

nouns.title: Rubric: 6-axis breakout utility and anti-hype filter under NodeGrid regimes
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic axis normalization and hype-penalty deductions separating runnable open-source tools from empty star-farmed repos.

axes.measures: Stars per day relative to repository age combined with Hacker News point and Hugging Face upvote velocity.
Presence of concrete CLI install and verification commands (pip, uvx, npx, cargo, docker, python3 -m) in README.
Non-trivial repository code footprint (size_kb) paired with healthy fork-to-star engagement ratio.
Permissive SPDX open-source license (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, MPL-2.0) vs unlicensed or ambiguous terms.
Independent sightings across GitHub Search, Hacker News Algolia and Hugging Face Daily Papers.
Alignment with practical security, self-hosted automation, MCP agent protocol, visual interactive or compact local runtime lenses.

anti_hype_penalties: no_license_penalty_milli when SPDX license is NONE or NOASSERTION
empty_or_tiny_repo_penalty_milli when repo_size_kb falls below min_substance_repo_kb
hype_phrase_penalty_milli when summary or README contains waitlist/presale/star-farming phrases
missing_quickstart_penalty_milli when zero runnable install or invocation commands are documented

relations: Feeds filtered high-substance repository candidates into downstream head-to-head Pareto benchmarking.

verbs.title: Harvest and normalize sanctioned public repository velocity signals while refusing credential-gated walls
network: Read-only HTTPS requests with explicit User-Agent and Accept: application/json against sanctioned public APIs when permitted by the worker harness; offline fixture evaluation uses zero network.
verbs.summary: Collect recent repository sightings from sanctioned public APIs (GitHub Search REST API, Hacker News Algolia Show HN, Hugging Face Daily Papers and Atom release feeds), enforce sanctioned_public_api_or_search_lens_only URL checks and normalize canonical github:<owner>/<repo> records.
verbs.outcome: Sanctioned normalized upstream velocity signals and explicit refusal records for any prohibited social wall URL.

slots.name: raw_signal_bundle
slots.description: Pin of raw upstream public API sightings, reference UTC timestamp and optional known archive map.

steps: Clamp lookback_window_days and simhash_hamming_dedup_max from the active NodeGrid cell.
Validate every source_url and repository_url via validate_sanctioned_source_url, refusing credential-gated social walls and normalizing canonical github:<owner>/<repo> keys.

acceptance.check: validate_sanctioned_source_url rejects all prohibited wall hosts with sanctioned_public_api_or_search_lens_only and canonicalize_repository_key normalizes repository URLs deterministically.

verbs.title: Coalesce multi-source sightings via 64-bit SimHash and score breakout utility vs star-farming hype
verbs.summary: Coalesce duplicate repository sightings across GitHub, Hacker News and Hugging Face using canonical keys and 64-bit shingle SimHash, cross-link existing seed archives without blind duplication, and score 6 utility axes minus anti-hype penalties.
verbs.outcome: Ranked VelocitySignalDossier records separating high-substance breakout tools from unlicensed or hype-shell repositories.

slots.name: normalized_signal_bundle
slots.description: Pin of sanctioned upstream sightings and target radar_regime.

steps: Compute 64-bit word-shingle SimHash digests and 4-band LSH prefixes, coalescing multi-channel sightings onto canonical github:<owner>/<repo> entries.
Compute 6 rubric axis scores and deduct anti-hype penalties for missing licenses, tiny code footprints, waitlist hype phrases or missing quickstarts.

acceptance.check: normalize_and_coalesce_signals coalesces multi-source sightings and score_breakout_dossier filters hype-shell candidates while admitting verified OSS tools.

verbs.title: Verify quickstart commands, SPDX license and runtime footprint and map into capability ontology facets
verbs.summary: Extract deterministic quickstart commands, SPDX license compatibility, runtime footprints (4GB laptop, CLI, container, Kubernetes) and integration hooks, linking each admitted repository into capability-ontology-and-benchmark-seeds facets.
verbs.outcome: Architecture-verified velocity dossier linked to polyhierarchical capability ontology facets and curator lenses.

slots.name: candidate_dossier_bundle
slots.description: Pin of scored repository dossiers for quickstart and ontology facet extraction.

steps: Extract runnable CLI install and verification commands from README excerpts and classify SPDX license compatibility.
Map repository capabilities onto polyhierarchical ontology facet IDs and runtime footprints (runs_on_small_4gb_laptop, cli_or_single_command_runner, kubernetes_production_ready).

acceptance.check: extract_quickstart_commands and match_capability_facets populate non-empty facet IDs, footprints and integration hooks matching template.velocity-signal-dossier.

verbs.title: Emit bounded verification, ontology-linking, adapter and runnable demo task proposals

verbs.outcome: Bounded follow-up task proposals preserving parent_task_id, source_task_id, facet_axes and search_hints with auto_enqueue_permitted: false.

slots.name: admitted_dossiers_bundle
slots.description: Pin of admitted velocity dossiers and parent lineage identifiers.

steps: Clamp max_proposals_per_artifact from the active NodeGrid cell and skip any repository where passes_breakout_gate is false.
Emit bounded +1 hop proposals carrying parent_task_id, source_task_id, facet_axes, search_hints and auto_enqueue_permitted: false.

acceptance.check: emit_bounded_verb_proposals caps output at max_proposals_per_artifact, increments generation_depth by 1 and sets auto_enqueue_permitted to false on every proposal.
